data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall Wikipedia → Booking → Notes flow and the note format right, but it misses the checkout parameter (it hardcodes a 1-night stay), the "first property with review score ≥ 8" rule (it takes the top-listed hotel) and the "don't click Reserve" constraint. It also lists derived values (landmark, population, hotel, price) as input parameters, and it adds an unneeded save step, so an automation built from it would be partly wrong.
